title: EXAMPLES-004: Image-saving examples call `fopen()`, `fwrite()`, and `fclose()` without checking the file handle or write count
description:
EXAMPLES-004: Image-saving examples call `fopen()`, `fwrite()`, and `fclose()` without checking the file handle or write count. Running from an unwritable directory or hitting disk errors can crash or silently produce corrupt example output. Check `fopen()` before writing, verify `fwrite()` writes one complete BLOB, and log errors with `strerror(errno)`. Fixed: Check file creation, byte count and close result; propagate errors, release URL BLOB ownership, and require image delivery before completion.

Imported from .factory/findings/archive/FND-000011.json (category: quality, blocking: no).
